name: smwgraphics-asm-animated-skewer
title: ASM-animated Skewer
description:
A castle smasher inspired by those from New Super Mario Bros Wii. It comes with UberASM Tool 2.0 code that animates it using Layer 2 Y position as a frame index, which gives it a screw-type movement.

Only the AN2 file is technically required; the BG3 file, which provides static graphics at the default animation location, is optional and mostly here to help placing the smashers in Lunar Magic.
